analysis.reasonEn: ADX at 18.7 indicates no trend formation. RSI at 45.6 is entering oversold territory. The 5-day low of 515.01 is higher than the 20-day low of 507.84, attempting a Higher Low. Volume ratio of 1.76 adds conviction to the move. However, the price is below the weekly SMA20 (-1.03%) and the weekly ADX is 18.2, suggesting potential weakening of the long-term trend. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($517.13) vs SMA5 ($522.16)/SMA20 ($519.27)/SMA50 ($521.14): indicating short-to-medium term trend below moving averages.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($522.02)/SMA200 ($503.29): in a weak medium-to-long term trend zone.

· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $509.30): approaching the lower band, with band width narrowing to 3.84%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance ($517.75): aligns with the pivot R1 level, a break above could signal a bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (attempting Higher Low): potential for a recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.76x): move is supported by increased volume, enhancing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider buying on a confirmed recovery of the 5-day low pattern.
